beats.text: Get ready to meet the cutest bundle of joy in the mountains.
Just five kilometers from the Somori Lake, these fluffy little rascals pop out of their burrows to greet you.
But don't let the charm fool you because they are precious protected species.
They feast almost entirely on the local grass.
So as soon as you edge closer, remember the golden rule.
Look, smile, snap a photo, but never ever share your snacks.
